item.title: Friday's front pauses the spring surge
item.description: Sunshine and southwest winds sent temperatures soaring Thursday afternoon, with afternoon highs 15° warmer than Wednesday. The warming trend will take a pause Saturday, but resumes on Sunday. We'll find clear and quiet weather tonight. Many spots won't even dip to the freezing mark as we find ourselves ahead of a cold front racing south. [...]

item.title: Missouri officials warn residents to take earthquake preparedness seriously
item.description: Missouri emergency officials are urging residents to take earthquake preparedness seriously as the state marks Earthquake Awareness Month, with the potential for a major event along the New Madrid Seismic Zone to have catastrophic consequences.

item.title: Mansfield woman pleads guilty to child abuse, drug charges
item.description: Meichkayla Leelaina Rawlings, 31, pleaded guilty to endangering the welfare of a child, drug possession and unlawful use of a weapon, and was sentenced to 5 years probation after investigators found her child locked in a bedroom with no bed, boarded up windows and a blocked bathroom door.
